message: The other day, I found myself searching for candles in the dark during a little storm, only to realize I had a shoebox full of them but no matches! 😅 It’s moments like these that remind me how important it is to be prepared for those unexpected weather events. I came across a handy guide that outlines what to have ready, just in case. Trust me, it’s way better than playing hide-and-seek with the light switches! What’s your storm prep story?
